reactor-elastic-moderation-kinematics-si.title: Neutron Elastic Moderation Kinematics in CM & LAB Frames
reactor-elastic-moderation-kinematics-si.desc: Simulates 2D elastic collision kinematics between a neutron and moderator nucleus (H, D, Be, C, U), calculating collision parameter α, average cosine μ0 = 2/(3A), logarithmic decrement ξ, and collision count.

reactor-slowing-down-density-resonance-s.title: Slowing-Down Density q(E) & Resonance Escape Probability
reactor-slowing-down-density-resonance-s.desc: Simulates continuous slowing-down epithermal flux ϕ(E) ~ 1/E, displaying sharp U-238 radiative capture resonances (6.67 eV, 20.9 eV, 36.7 eV) and Doppler broadening temperature effects on resonance escape p.

reactor-fick-diffusion-flux-sim.title: Neutron Diffusion Theory & Fick's Law Flux Profiles
reactor-fick-diffusion-flux-sim.desc: Solves steady-state 1D/radial neutron diffusion equation -D∇²ϕ + Σa ϕ = S(r), demonstrating Fick's Law J = -D∇ϕ, thermal diffusion length L = √(D/Σa), and extrapolated boundary d = 0.71 λtr.

reactor-fermi-age-slowing-sim.title: Fermi Age Theory & Fast Neutron Slowing-Down Density
reactor-fermi-age-slowing-sim.desc: Solves the Fermi Age diffusion equation ∇²q = ∂q/∂τ, showing the Gaussian spatial spreading of fast neutrons q(r, τ) as age τ increases from fission birth to thermal energy.
